column4: componentize-py is not installed on this runner, and this test needs a real Python guest: it asserts that a guest side_effect function runs once across a first run and its replay (cleat#4113), which only running one can show. It runs and passes in Cross-Language E2E, where componentize-py is installed; the engine test-go job has its own skip-baseline line.
